title: FAQ | Good Hemp Distro
meta_description: Frequently asked questions about Good Hemp Distro

questions.a: Good Hemp Distro is a community marketplace connecting hemp producers, vendors, and buyers across the supply chain.

questions.q: How do I become a vendor?
questions.a: Register via Vendor Registration and complete the verification process. Once approved, you can list products immediately.

questions.q: What products are listed on the marketplace?
questions.a: We support CBD wellness products, industrial hemp, hemp-based services, and recreational hemp where legally permitted.
Wholesale buyers can apply through the Wholesale section. Access is granted after identity and business verification.

questions.q: Who do I contact for support?
questions.a: Reach us through the Contact or Support pages. Our team typically responds within one business day.
